$comment: Every string a component renders. Add ui.<locale>.json to translate.
siteTagline: Get ready to represent The Labs.

page.noStoryYet: You haven't saved a 30-second why yet.
page.reviewFrom: All read. Review from the start

home.firstTitle: Get ready to represent The Labs.
home.firstLede: Learn to explain The Labs, run a good conversation, and give a short talk. No account needed. Your progress stays on this device.
home.returningLede: Refresh a playbook, or open the deck and present.
home.resume: Pick up where you left off
home.firstCardBody: What the role is, the minimum we ask, and where to go next.
home.pathNote: About 45 minutes in total, in as many sittings as you like.
home.toolPracticeSub: Situations to think through, one at a time
home.toolDeckSub: Present the deck from any browser
home.toolHelpSub: Who to ask, and what's changed

practice.title: Practice
practice.prompt: What would you say? Say it in your head first.
practice.lede: Read each situation, decide what you'd say, then reveal an example reply. No scoring, no typing.
practice.selfCheck: How close was yours? Only you see this.

story.title: Your Story
story.lede: Write a 30-second why you can say naturally. Answer a few prompts, and we'll put together a draft you can edit freely. It stays on this device.
story.reassembleNote: Building a new draft replaces what's in the box below.
story.target: Aim for about 65 to 85 words, about 30 seconds.
story.clearConfirm: Clear your saved answers and draft from this device?
story.draftHelp: Edit it until it sounds like you. Read it out loud with the timer below.
story.bandShort: A little short. Add a detail.
story.bandLong: Over 30 seconds. Cut the setup, not the change.

refresher.title: Refreshers
refresher.lede: One screen per playbook, for the night before. Each one prints on a single page.
refresher.practiceSub: Cards you marked Not yet come back first

deck.title: Deck
deck.lede: Present the boilerplate deck from any browser. No login, no download. It works offline after you've opened it once.
deck.presentLede: Arrows, click, or swipe to move. F for full screen. ? for all keys.
deck.customizeLede: Tailor a copy of the Canva template for a specific event.
deck.assets: Approved photos, proof points, and logos
deck.copyFresh: Make a fresh copy for every event.
deck.notesSub: Current and next slide, cues, and a pacing timer. Controls a second window.
deck.practiceSub: Talk cues under each slide, for rehearsing

present.hint: Arrows, click, or swipe. F full screen. ? for all keys.

help.title: Help & Updates
help.progressLede: Your read progress and story are stored only in this browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
help.resetConfirm: Reset your read progress on this device? Your saved story stays.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.lede: This page hasn't been saved on this device yet. Pages you've opened before, the refreshers, and the deck work offline.

footer.legal: The Upskilling Labs is a fiscally sponsored project of Superbloom Design, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit.

invite.title: Invite with a date
invite.template: "The next {what} is {day} at {time}, at {place}. Want the link?"
invite.fallback: "The next dates are on theupskillinglabs.org. Want the link?"
invite.note: An example, not a line. A date and a place make it easy to say yes.
